name: Rhino Boots
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 5; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

These tough gray, leather boots have upward pointed toes. The wearer of a pair of rhino boots can charge as a standard action rather than as a full round action and +10 foot enhancement bonus to move speed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, haste
